_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "Send X" means: fill the message input (data-testid "message-input") with X, click the send button (data-testid "send-button"), and wait (up to 30s) until the message input's value is exactly "". A "reader" is a BTW thread shown inline, [data-testid="btw-inline"]; "the reader for X" is the one containing the text X. Inside a reader: its answers are ".btw-inline-answer", its expand/collapse toggle is ".btw-inline-label", its body is ".btw-inline-body", its follow-up box is "[data-btw-follow-up]", and its action buttons are found by their text ("Summarize to input", "Dismiss", "Cancel") or label (button[aria-label="Submit follow up"]); its "Open subagent" link is the a.btw-inline-open-subagent. "The Stop button" is button[aria-label="Stop"]. "The reader for X has completed N turns" means: eval window.btwCompleted(X, N) with expect "true" (it checks the reader's child conversation on the server); then the reader's "Summarize to input" button should be visible (up to 30s), and its follow-up box should be enabled. The parent conversation and sibling BTW readers stay independent through a follow-up, a summary and reloads. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/btw-parent and wait (up to 30s) for the message input to be visible. 2. Send "{{PARENT_BARRIER}}" (a bash command that blocks until stopped). The Stop button should be visible. 3. Send "/btw echo: side one", then send "/btw echo: side two". 4. There should be exactly two readers (up to 30s). The reader for "echo: side one" should have an answer containing "side one", and the reader for "echo: side two" an answer containing "side two". 5. The reader for "echo: side one" has completed 1 turn, and the reader for "echo: side two" has completed 1 turn. 6. Click the Stop button; it should be gone (count 0, up to 30s), and there should still be exactly two readers. 7. In the reader for "echo: side one": fill its follow-up box with "unsent follow-up"; click its toggle, and its body should become hidden; click its toggle again, and its follow-up box's value should be exactly "unsent follow-up". 8. Fill that follow-up box with "echo: follow-up answer" and click that reader's Submit follow up button. That reader's last answer should come to contain "follow-up answer" (up to 30s). 9. The reader for "echo: side one" has completed 2 turns. 10. Click that reader's "Summarize to input" button. The message input's value should become exactly "edit predictable.go to add a response for that one..." (up to 30s). 11. Reload the page. The message input's value should be exactly "edit predictable.go to add a response for that one..." (up to 30s), and there should be exactly two readers. 12. Remember the reader for "echo: side one"'s child conversation: eval window.__dismissed = <that reader>.getAttribute('data-btw-exchange-id'), which must be non-empty. 13. Click that reader's "Dismiss" button. The reader for "echo: side one" should be gone (count 0, up to 30s), leaving exactly one reader. 14. The dismissed reader's child conversation still exists: eval fetch('/api/conversation/' + window.__dismissed).then(r => r.ok) with expect "true". 15. Reload the page. There must be no reader for "echo: side one", and exactly one reader. 16. Click the "Open subagent" link of the reader for "echo: side two". The URL path should come to start with "/c/btw-" (up to 10s).
